intent: Show that the number of people flagged for far-right activity rose by more than a third between 2016-17 and 2017-18.

requirements.question: How much did the number of people flagged for far-right activity change between 2016-17 and 2017-18?

units.claim: The number of people flagged for far-right activity rose by more than a third (>33.3%) from 2016-17 to 2017-18.
accept: the 2017-18 bar is at least one-third taller
reject: an invented absolute count (e.g. exactly 1,400 people)
missing one of the two periods
units.evidence: Two bars: 2017-18 is at least one-third taller than 2016-17.

optional_valid: About 40% is a bar-height estimate, not a printed value; absolute counts are unknown.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
